url_policy: A Kick VOD is served at kick.com/<channel>/videos/<uuid>. The bare kick.com/video/<uuid> form 404s: measured 2026-09-22, 0 of 6 sampled VODs resolved on it and 6 of 6 resolved on the channel form. 28 of her 29 Kick rows carried the dead form, so every Kick link on the Live tab was broken.
playability: Every YouTube night was fetched and judged on its playerResponse status, 2026-09-22: 194 OK, 8 UNPLAYABLE. An http code cannot tell these apart, because a dead id still answers 200. The 8 unplayable rows are exactly the rows with no provable date. Kick was measured the same way, through the endpoint the player itself calls: 28 of 29 hand over a source, 1 has been deleted by Kick and its channel page still answers 200.
